column3: Collect $1oa Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
column4:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.

column3: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.
column4:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.

column3: Gather $1oa Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.
column4: It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.\r\n\r\nDuring the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.

column3: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.
column4:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.Escort Bareth Dawnstone out of Crusader's Outpost

column3: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
column4:
Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...

column3: Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike.  Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.
column4: The Stormpike dwarves and their allies have invaded Alterac Valley, and we must drive them out!  To win the battle for Alterac, we must defeat their general, Vanndar Stormpike!$B$BYou will find Vanndar in Dun Baldar, in the north of Alterac Valley.$B$BDestroy him, $n, and then return to me.Defeat Vanndar Stormpike.

column3: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
column4: You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.\r\n\r\nIf you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.

column3: Collect $1oa Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
column4: My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."\r\n\r\nIf you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.

column3: Bring Shelene Rhobart $1oa Duskbat Wing Membranes, $2oa Darkhound Hides and $3oa Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
column4:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, $n. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.

column3: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.$B$BBe warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.
column4: Naturally, with my brother still alive, there may be some contention as to the primary beneficiary of the family's fortune. This cannot be.$B$BA low down guttersnipe like you isn't above a little cold-blooded murder, I hope.$B$BIt's a simple task and one that I expect you will complete; that is, if you wish to claim your reward.$B$BWeldon sits under Alliance protection at Chillwind Camp, to the east. Slay him, return his head.$B$B<Alexi yawns.>$B$BHurry along now.
